messages:
allison_marketing: Hey team — final copy lock request for the product launch post. I pushed the latest draft here: https://docs.example.com/launch-draft. Need signoff on benchmark callouts, EU/JP localization strings, and the inbound lead routing paragraph. Can we aim for EOD tomorrow? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon_growth: On lead routing — should we split CTAs by region? thinking: EU -> sales-eu, NA -> sales-ps, APAC -> partner-team. Also want to add an alternate CTA for webinar registrants vs on-demand viewers.

omar_pm: Quick question on the benchmark line: we currently say "30% faster inference on common request patterns" — what's the source for that? is it internal Redwood bench v3 or partner tests? need exact phrasing or a citation.

rita_legal: Flagging the benchmark claim — we'll need the test methodology or remove the comparative wording. Also watch the phrase "industry-leading" — prefer "industry-competitive" unless we have substantiation.

leah_ops: Demo/webinar ops here — for webinar CTA routing: if we route EU -> sales-eu, we also need timezone-aware demo slots. We have 3 EU-friendly demo slots per week available; capacity note: max 40 registrants before we need a second host.

allison_marketing: Thanks — Omar, it's internal bench v3 (run on v100/rtx cluster) — I'll paste the short methodology below. Rita: will reword "industry-leading" to "industry-competitive" unless legal confirms. Devon: can you draft the CTA split and A/B text options? Leah: noted capacity, we'll add a note to the ops doc.

marketing-bot: Reminder: draft deadline in 20 hours for #marketing review.

omar_pm: Methodology snippet from bench v3: ```3000 sample requests, mixed seq lengths 64/256, average tail-latency measured at p99 across 10 runs. Baseline = open-model-x on same infra.``` Use this as the citation block in the post.

rita_legal: Ok that methodology is acceptable as long as the baseline model is named and the infra parity is clear. Suggest final sentence: "based on internal benchmark v3 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware."

devon_growth: CTA options (first pass):
- Variant A (webinar-first): "See a live demo & join our launch webinar" -> tags: `lead:webinar`, `route:sales-eu|sales-ps|partner-apac`
- Variant B (docs-first): "Read the quickstart & get started" -> tags: `lead:docs`, `route:cdn-leads`
Happy to A/B test for two weeks.

allison_marketing: Nice. Can you add copy variants for JP localization? keep length ~45 chars.

devon_growth: Sure — JP short copies: Variant A: "ライブデモを見る" Variant B: "クイックスタートを読む". I'll drop them into the draft.

leah_ops: For routing snippet, please include this mapping in the ops playbook: ```region_map = {"EU": "sales-eu", "NA": "sales-ps", "APAC": "partner-apac"}``` Also: webinar capacity -> set auto-waitlist at 40.

allison_marketing: Updated the draft with the methodology block, CTA variants, and routing notes. Link: https://docs.example.com/launch-draft#v4. Please skim for final nitpicks.

rita_legal: Quick nit: change "substantial cost savings" to "meaningful cost reductions" and remove the word "guarantee." Otherwise LGTM from legal after that tweak.

omar_pm: small edit suggestion on benchmark paragraph: replace "30% faster" with "~30% faster (p99)", makes it clear metric.

devon_growth: A/B test plan approved from growth side. I'll prepare experiment tags and a small GA tracking snippet.

allison_marketing: Perfect — I've made Rita and Omar's wording updates and pushed v4. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll mark copy locked and schedule publish. Thanks all :rocket:
